title: Rate Lock Commitment Relock Terms Schedule
content:
An expired **Rate Lock Commitment** can be relocked on the terms set for its product. The schedule gives each term.

| Rate Lock Commitment product | Relock window after expiration (calendar days) | Relock fee (points) | Relock term from the relock date (days) | Maximum relocks per lock | New lock at current market terms required past the window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock | 30 | 0.125 | 15 | 1 | Yes |
| Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock | 30 | 0.125 | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock | 30 | 0.125 | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock | 30 | 0.125 | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock | 30 | 0.250 | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock | 30 | 0.250 | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock | 30 | 0.250 | 30 | 2 | Yes |

**Definitions**

- **Relock window**: the number of calendar days after expiration during which the lock can be relocked at worst-case pricing.
- **Relock fee**: a fee, in points to 3 decimals, added to the worst-case price.
- **Relock term**: the term of a relock, in days counted from the relock date.
- **Maximum relocks**: the greatest number of times one lock can be relocked.
- **New lock past the window**: a borrower past the relock window must take a new lock at current market terms. This applies to every product.

### Notes

- Only the Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock allows 2 relocks. Every other product allows 1.
- The relock term of the Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock is 15 days. Every other product relocks for 30 days.
- The relock fee is 0.125 points for the 15- to 60-day locks and 0.250 points for the 90-, 120- and 180-day locks.
